messages:
maria: Quick postmortem note from the stress test: when we split CP and created new peering attachments, some route tables propagated slower causing a 20-60s window of blackholed control traffic for affected tenants.

nate: Was this limited to cross-account peering or intra-account too?

maria: Mostly cross-account peering where route propagation depends on attachment state across accounts. Intra-account was faster.

jack: Observable symptoms? We saw control RPCs time out at 10s and then clients retried to the fallback region. That triggered duplicate onboarding attempts and transient token mismatch logs.

maria: Exactly. For customers with strict egress allowlists this looked like IP flip + auth failures because retries hit the fallback NAT.

nate: Two mitigations: (A) delay route cutover until route propagation confirmed (probe), or (B) pre-warm target relays with session proxy so traffic never goes to unready relays. Tradeoffs?

jack: (A) is simple but increases cutover time. (B) keeps fast cutovers but needs sticky session proxy and more infra. Also B complicates Private deployments where customer controls the peering.

maria: Proposal: default to (A) with a short probe loop: after attach, controller probes dataplane using controlplane-level healthcheck via the new path until we see consistent reply for 3 consecutive probes (1s interval). If probes timeout > 90s, fall back to planned slow path and alert.

nate: Add a per-tenant override to use pre-warm proxy if customer opts in (e.g., scale-critical tenants). That way power users pay for lower cutover latency.

jack: Metrics to add: route_prop_latency, route_probe_success, blackhole_incidents. Alert when probe_success < 0.95 over 5m.

security: Add a note on audit: record snapshot of route-table IDs and peering attachment IDs in controller logs with a correlation id so we can trace which attach caused the blackhole. Also ensure we redact customer IPs in public dashboards.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: new alert rule suggested: cp_route_probe_failure. Pager: eng-oncall + neteng.

maria: Rollout plan: implement probe + 90s timeout, surface banner in Console for tenants in-progress, add per-tenant pre-warm flag, and update oncall playbook. I'll open RFC "cp-peering-route-probe" with sequence and CLI snippets.

nate: Small CLI snippet for debugging:

```
# probe dataplane path to verify route
curl -H "X-Cp-Probe: <id>" https://relay-<tenant>.region.internal/_cp_probe
```

jack: We'll also add integration test that simulates delayed propagation and asserts controller waits.

maria: Thanks all. RFC incoming. :thumbsup:
